briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and DeepSeek R2 escalate AGI capability race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while regulatory pressure mounts on export controls. Funding remains robust but concentrated among hyperscalers. Prompt injection and multi-agent security gaps continue to dominate deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind launched Gemini 2.5 Pro; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI and DeepSeek both dropped new reasoning models this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips; Microsoft announced $9B data center expansion in Texas; NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10-trillion-parameter model trigger an international compute-sharing treaty by 2027?
